decision.reason: The only evidence [ev-a0994163965b] is a one-line changelog title: ApplicationSet "generated app errors should use the default requeue". It does not name an API group or version. It also doesn't say what the earlier requeue behavior was or when it applied. That leaves the proposed exposure unsupported: no evidence covers the v1alpha1/v1beta1 ApplicationSet versions it lists, and it flags every ApplicationSet user. The fix seems to apply only when generated Applications hit errors at runtime, which configuration alone can't show. Deciding this needs the PR (#21887/#21936) description or diff showing the old and new requeue behavior and the error conditions that trigger it.
